messages:
Dmitri: Starting weighted fanout for api-gateway v2.1.0 in eu-west. Change window 11:30-12:30 UTC. Plan: 0->10% (5m) -> 50% (10m) -> 100% (gradual). Rollback criteria: p95 > 300ms for 5m OR error-rate > 1.5x baseline. Tagging oncall + @Alice M for console watch.
DeployBot: deploy started id=deploy-20260321-1799994321 target=api-gateway:v2.1.0 mode=blue-green region=eu-west.
Alice M: I'll validate router priming and LB warm pool before first shift and post baseline snapshots.
Ben: Quick Q  are downstream connections pinned to v2.1.0? saw sticky conn flaps last release.
Dmitri: We pin route rules to target-tag=v2.1.0; session affinity via cookie TTL=2m.
Carla: LB plan snippet:
```
# using routerctl to apply gradual weights
routerctl set-weight gateway-eu-west blue 90 green 10 --hold 300s
# after steady: routerctl set-weight blue 50 green 50
```
We'll use hold windows and sanity probes (200s).
Eva L: I'll run auth + billing smoke once 10% is live, report in ~3m.
DeployBot: healthcheck: /healthz ok on green nodes (n=12). KV cache primed.
Alice M: Pre-roll baseline: p50 30ms p95 120ms errors 0.02% 5xx 0.003%. Baseline saved -> /dash/eng/gateway/eu-west/baseline.
Dmitri: Rolling 10% now. Stand by for p95 or error spikes.
DeployBot: roll step complete green=10% blue=90% (ts=1799994340).
Ben: Noticing p95 uptick on some pods -> 210ms. Investigating cold-starts.
Alice M: Check for KV cache misses or jar reloads; if p95 >250ms sustained for 3m we rollback.
Carla: Extending hold +2m to observe.
DeployBot: probe: p95(green)=220ms p95(blue)=120ms error(green)=0.03%.
Dmitri: Still under error threshold, but watch closely.
Eva L: Auth smoke 10/10. Billing 9/10 with one transient 502, logged.
Ben: Pushing a small config fix that will restart a couple pods. ETA 4m.
Dmitri: If restarts finish and p95 improves, proceed to 50%. Otherwise revert.
DeployBot: admin: canary-pin trace-sampling=true on green nodes.
Alice M: Pinning traces helps triage. Preparing canary logs.
DeployBot: roll step initiated green=50% blue=50% (ts=1799994360).
Dmitri: Eyes on p95 for next 10m. Ben call if you see anomalies beyond warm-up.
Ben: p95(green) trending down to 160ms as inits finish; errors stable. Seems safe.
Dmitri: Proceeding to final fanout in ~8m unless objections.
Carla: routerctl dry-run ok for final sweep.
Eva L: Final smoke scheduled +8m.
DeployBot: final shift scheduled in 8m; rollback triggers active.
Alice M: No objections. Dashboard pinned and alerts armed.
Dmitri: Reminder rollback plan: instant revert weights to blue=100% + cordon/evict green, open incident channel.
Ben: Ready to flip if needed.
DeployBot: deploy complete green=100% blue=0% (ts=1799994375).
